text.en:
The name of the Calimbajan Elementary School located in the Municipality of Makato, Province
of Aklan, is changed to Assemblyman Manuel T. Terencio, Sr. Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 7, 1984
